data.name: moreFilters_description
data.value: Choose which rows the table shows. The number next to a filter is the number of rows it matches.

data.name: isActive_description
data.value: Turns the diagnostic on or off for you. Your choice overrides the value set by the rule and is saved in your settings, so it applies to every document.

data.name: severity_description
data.value: Sets how serious you consider the findings of the diagnostic. Your choice overrides the level set by the rule and is saved in your settings.

data.name: search_description
data.value: Searches the code and the description, ignoring case. The list is updated when you leave the field.

data.name: checkAll_description
data.value: Turns on every diagnostic, including the ones hidden by the search and the filters.

data.name: uncheckAll_description
data.value: Turns off every diagnostic, including the ones hidden by the search and the filters.

data.name: checkVisible_description
data.value: Turns on only the diagnostics shown in the list now, after the search and the filters.

data.name: uncheckVisible_description
data.value: Turns off only the diagnostics shown in the list now, after the search and the filters.

data.name: invertAll_description
data.value: Switches every diagnostic to the opposite state, including the ones hidden by the search and the filters.

data.name: invertVisible_description
data.value: Switches only the diagnostics shown in the list now to the opposite state.
